summary: Resamples polygon primitives into even-length or axis-based segments, converting NURBS or Bezier input to polygons using level of detail first.

key_params.name: lod
key_params.note: Level of Detail for converting non-polygons

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: Even length, X, Y, or Z segmentation

common_gotchas: Non-polygon inputs are converted before resampling, so LOD affects the final point distribution.
Per-edge mode preserves corners and disables the Measure method.
When both maximum length and maximum segments are enabled, the output may be constrained shorter than the original curve.
When neither length nor segment count is selected, the input curve is merely converted to a polygon.
key_concepts: Resample SOP operates on polygons; NURBS and Bezier inputs are converted to polygons using Level of Detail first.
It can resample an entire polygon or preserve corners by resampling per polygon edge.
Segmenting can be even-length or axis-based, with arc or chord measurement for curved spline sections.
Maximum Segment Length and Maximum Segments interact to constrain segment count and segment length.
